summary: Reconciliation worker killed after exceeding its memory limit during a large import
details: A full-ledger export of 1.2M records was processed in a single in-memory batch. Heap grew past the 4GiB container limit and the worker was OOMKilled. Logs showed 'out of memory while processing records'.
resolution: Switched the import to streaming batches of 10k records and raised the container memory limit to 6GiB.

summary: Nightly export job failed with permission denied writing to the reports bucket
details: A credential rotation removed the service account's storage.objectCreate role. Every write returned 403 permission denied.
resolution: Re-granted the writer role to the job's service account and added an IAM policy check to the deploy pipeline.

summary: Payment webhook processor timed out calling the ledger service
details: p99 latency on the ledger service spiked during a deploy; webhook calls exceeded the 5s client timeout and the queue backed up.
resolution: Raised the client timeout to 15s, added retry with exponential backoff, and gated ledger deploys on latency SLOs.

summary: ETL pipeline crashed on schema mismatch after an upstream column rename
details: The vendor feed renamed 'customer_id' to 'customerId'. The parser raised a parse error and the whole batch failed instead of quarantining bad records.
resolution: Added schema validation with a quarantine path for malformed records and a contract test against the vendor feed.

summary: Search indexer failed with no space left on device
details: Index snapshots were never pruned; the data volume filled up and writes failed with ENOSPC.
resolution: Added snapshot retention of 7 days, disk-usage alerts at 80%, and expanded the volume.

summary: Report generator failed with connection refused to the metadata database
details: A network policy change blocked the job's namespace from reaching the database. All connections were refused at startup.
resolution: Fixed the network policy selector and added a connectivity preflight check to the job.

summary: Billing sync aborted: missing environment variable STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
details: A refactor renamed the variable in the deployment manifest but not in the application config. The job failed at startup with a configuration error.
resolution: Restored the variable name and added startup validation that fails fast with a clear message listing missing configuration.

summary: Large CSV import worker ran out of memory building an in-memory join
details: Joining two large datasets in pandas doubled peak memory; the worker exceeded its limit on month-end volumes with 'MemoryError'.
resolution: Moved the join into the warehouse (SQL) and streamed only the joined result, cutting peak memory by 85%.
